Applications / Portable DP

Modular thrust for temporary positioning.

Towbot provides detachable electric thrust for marine construction, dredging, jack-up support and offshore campaigns where a permanent DP installation is not justified.

Request an assessment ↗ View product range

Project types

Where portable DP adds value.

A complete positioning package requires power, position-reference systems, control architecture, procedures and assurance. Towbot provides the thruster component within that system.

Marine construction

Dredging and pipelaying

Work barges and crane vessels requiring precise positioning during construction operations, where anchor handling is impractical or the seabed cannot accept anchor loads.

Offshore support

Jack-up and campaign work

Support vessels and work platforms for offshore wind, oil and gas campaigns that need temporary positioning capability for a defined project scope.

Transhipment

Floating terminals

Floating transhipment operations requiring maintained position relative to a berth or vessel during cargo transfer in exposed or tidal locations.

Important qualification

What portable DP means for Towbot.

Towbot provides the thruster component. A complete portable DP installation requires additional engineering.

  • Multiple units deployable on a single asset for redundancy
  • Scalable thrust — configuration matched to positioning requirement
  • No permanent installation — mobilise with the project
  • Battery-electric — zero local emissions during operation
  • Detach and redeploy to the next project on completion
System integration required.

A complete portable DP installation also needs position-reference systems, power distribution, control architecture, operating procedures and a defined assurance pathway. A Towbot configuration is not automatically a class-approved DP system — the required redundancy, class notation and environmental envelope are defined for each project.
